summary: The Samsung Galaxy S24 Ultra is a high-performing smartphone with excellent battery life, fast charging, and an impressive 200MP camera, though it is held back slightly by its heavy weight, software bloatware, and expensive price tag.
pros: 5000mAh battery lasts a full day with 45W fast charging
S-Pen integration for notes and sketches
Stunning 200MP camera with crisp night mode
cons: Uncomfortable for one-handed use due to size and weight
One UI includes duplicate Samsung bloatware apps
